subject: 云居寺辽代北塔
author: Siyuwj
source_note: 所绘为北塔，不含南塔与石经；树木遮挡的下部按可见层级连续意写。
prompt: Create one precise, sparse Chinese heritage INK LINE DRAWING of Yunju Temple NORTH Pagoda (云居寺辽代北塔) in Fangshan Beijing. Image 1 is the real subject photograph; image 2 is only the project's fine black-outline style sample. Preserve the tower's unusual exact profile: square multi-story lower brick base, pronounced projecting bracket eaves at two levels, a transitional wider rounded drum, tall tapering stack of closely spaced conical rings, and small terminal finial. Show the complete tower from foot to tip from a slightly frontal three-quarter angle, replacing foliage-occluded lower portions with simple plausible continuations, avoiding invented extra floors. Include visible arched niches and restrained brick joints. Remove trees, bushes, sky, modern signs, landscape and people. Thin charcoal-black contour strokes, minimal texture, no filled black masses, no writing. Center portrait composition with generous margin. Entire canvas must be flat opaque PURE WHITE #FFFFFF including exterior background; no shadows, gradients, paper grain, glow, checkerboard or transparent canvas.
